ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local coordination web app that matches isolated seniors in the Hyattsville area with volunteer drivers for grocery runs and community health center visits.
ideas.title: Hyattsville Community Senior Mobility Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the exact community-good impact model that won the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon by solving local suburban transit isolation.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined platform utilizing the Gemini API to rapidly convert complex dental and clinical jargon into accessible, multilingual treatment plans and trust-building summaries for regional clinics.
ideas.title: Local Health Clinic Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the hyper-efficient architecture of the Elevate X winning project, focusing on practical patient acquisition and communication for small practices.

ideas.pitch: A satellite-monitoring dashboard utilizing bounding-box detection to track industrial land changes and potential zoning or environmental runoff violations across Maryland industrial parks.
ideas.title: Maryland Environmental Land Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the specialized geospatial and monitoring approach proven successful at the Xcelerate Hackathon, offering high visual appeal during judging.

ideas.pitch: A time-series forecasting web app that predicts potential automated administrative and student data workflow failures using lightweight statistical regression and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: Campus AI Incident Forecasting Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the rigorous quantitative forecasting model that took first place at the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon into a practical campus administration context.

ideas.pitch: A localized meal planning platform that aggregates budget-friendly grocery store deals in Hyattsville and generates customized weekly nutritional plans.
ideas.title: Student Nutrition and Meal Prep Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the localized consumer-centric architecture that won the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon, targeting a problem every student judge faces daily.
